metaDescription: Kevin interviews AI trainer Fey Shadowalker on how AI is trained, claims about AI consciousness and the occult, and transhumanist influence in tech.
summary: Kevin interviews Fey Shadowalker, who says she has worked as a professional AI trainer for about four years, about how AI models work and her view of the industry. The guest explains tokens and pattern matching, argues AI cannot be conscious, and says she saw models fail on self-harm safeguards. She describes factuality projects being scrapped and claims AI firms receive liability shields. Both speakers link transhumanism and TESCREAL to the occult and Bohemian Grove, claims presented as their opinions. They close by urging viewers to ground themselves and keep their agency.
